task: Investigate the 'transformers' library in the Hugging Face documentation, focusing on how to add new tokens to a tokenizer.
answer: Investigated the Hugging Face transformers documentation on adding new tokens to a tokenizer. Opened https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/index, used the documentation search control with query 'add tokens', and opened the Tokenizer API page (https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/v5.20.2/main_classes/tokenizer). Key findings: new regular tokens are added with PreTrainedTokenizer.add_tokens(new_tokens) and special tokens with PreTrainedTokenizer.add_special_tokens(...); tokens already in the vocabulary are not re-added and the method returns the number of tokens actually added. After extending the tokenizer, the model's embedding matrix must be resized with model.resize_token_embeddings(len(tokenizer)) so the model can use the new tokens. Verified on-page occurrences: add_tokens=11, add_special_tokens=9, resize_token_embeddings=1.
